title: check-hints/<child>.json — one child's verification check hints (authored, never derived)
description: One file per child, authored by that child's wave-2 sub-Task: children are written in parallel, so a shared file would be a write conflict. check_id is unique across all children (derive-plan-data), source_feature resolves to a features.json id (check-coverage), and implementation_detail_verbatim is the sole downstream source of cycle-accurate refmodel formulas — token survival is what enforces it. Field names match the scaffold's inlined_check_hints[], so the injection is a verbatim copy.

check_id.description: Unique across every child. testpoints[].covers[] refers to it.

source_feature.description: A features.json id. Every feature must be named by at least one hint.

implementation_detail.description: Short summary of what is checked.

implementation_detail_verbatim.description: The brainstorm-original RTL formula or token, uncompressed — or the narrative-only marker when the brainstorm states no formula. Optional in shape; token survival is what actually enforces it.

brainstorm_anchor.description: Optional traceability pointer (e.g. L46). No script consumes it.

observable.description: The signal or port the check observes.

reference_rule.description: The reference-model rule the observable is judged against.

latency.description: Optional. Cycles between stimulus and observable effect.

reset_behavior.description: Optional. The observable's value under reset.
